title: Executive Director
description:
Lead all ICAC legal strategy and serve as Chief Legal Advisor.
Direct complex corruption prosecution, asset recovery, and litigation
Must have current PNG practicing certificate
A Career of Integrity: Join the Papua New Guinea ICAC
The
Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC)
, established by the Constitution and the
Organic Law on the ICAC 2020
(
OLICAC
), is the lead agency dedicated to
preventing, reducing, and combating corrupt conduct
across Papua New Guinea. They offer a career of profound national impact, demanding the highest standards of
integrity, professionalism, and courage
. Join the organisation to be an integrity role model and shape the future of a vital national institution.
They are seeking exceptional, experienced professionals to fill this pivotal
Executive Director
role to lead a core operational and strategic division. As a member of ICAC’s senior executive team, you will provide strategic direction and operational oversight to drive the Commission’s mandate.
Lead the Legal Battle Against Corruption
Our client is seeking an accomplished legal professional to step into the role of
Executive Director, Legal Services Division
. This role serves as the
Chief Legal Advisor
and General Counsel to the Commission, overseeing a broad spectrum of legal functions, including, prosecutions of complex corruption and serious fraud cases and recovery of assets following the
Proceeds of Crimes
Act.
This is a strategic leadership position that requires profound legal expertise to navigate constitutional matters, complex litigation, and high-stakes anti-corruption prosecution.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as
General Counsel
to the Commission, providing high-level legal advice.
Lead the prosecution of
complex corruption
and
serious fraud
cases, including asset recovery.
Oversee and direct all legal functions, including constitutional law and civil litigation.
Represent the ICAC in court proceedings and support Commission Hearings.
Plan, organize, and manage the staff and resources of the Legal and Prosecution branches.
Key Requirements
Bachelor’s Degree in Law, with a Master's degree as an advantage.
Minimum
10 years of legal experience
with
7 years or more in a senior management role
.
Admitted to practice law in PNG with a
current practising certificate
.
In-depth knowledge and proven experience in
litigation
across relevant areas of law.
Extensive knowledge of
Constitutional Law
,
OLICAC
, and litigation
Demonstrated
Strategic Leadership
and high ethical standards (Integrity).
Strong advocacy, analytical, and strategic leadership skills.
Apply Now to Make a Difference
If you are an exceptional legal leader with a steadfast commitment to justice, take this opportunity to apply and secure your role in protecting PNG’s future.
Please submit your CV and cover letter outlining your experience against the key requirements.
Only applicants committed to the highest ethical standards need apply.
Applications close at 5:00 PM, 14th November 2025.
Female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply
